{{Top|leg}}
'''Consul of Natural Resources''' was one of twelve [[Consul/Legends|consul]] positions comprising the [[Bothan Colonial Board|Bothan colonial board]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].

The consul was responsible for all businesses relating to water supply, agriculture, pollution control, (later) recycling and anything else having to do with natural resources.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Shrithek Al'lya]] held this position.
